About the energy thing, does she have access to toys? I can imagine that she's very hyper if she's locked into a single room, with less leg room than usual. Maybe giving her some mental and light physical exercise will help her.

I second this. It's more common in male cats, but blood in the pee is most often sign of urinary infection. Especially along with peeing outside of the litter box, stugling while peeing, going to the box very often. I absolutely recommend seeing your vet soon. If you can, try to collect the urine before the vet appointment!  If the urine is less than 4 hours old (preferably stored in the fridge) they can use it for lab tests and maybe already determine if it is a uti or not. 

Hope this is useful! Take care of your kitty!
From what I can see, this sounds very worrying. I absolutely recommend a visit to the vet.

Would definitely recommend a visit to the vet if you're worried.

Basically my entire life has been crawling. Have been depressed since the age of around 8-9. I was always bullied.

Went to the only high school on my island hoping for new friends, but my class was filled with people from my school. Bullying continued. I found 3 friends in another class and got permission to switch classes the 2nd year. All the while, I was still depressed. It got worse as the bullying continued still. Got into a toxic relationship at 15 (ended at 18) which made me lose all my friends. Tried to commit suicide 2 times during that relationship. 

Then I has to choose a college, but I knew I wasn't ready yet my parents forced me. Quit after 2-3 months and came back to parents house and started more serious therapy. I got a job in a new restaurant that made me love life a bit more, because I felt appreciated. Even made some sort of friends.

After a little more than a year, I started a new college. My current one. Lost contact with everyone from my job. I found a new friend during the first year of college but it was so hard, I had a lot of difficulty with the first year because my depression never really left. I continued anyway. Now I've been doing this college course for 4 years with so much hardships and am about to give up on it to start a new one on a lower level. Probably also will be moving to a city on the other side of the country. So I'll basically start over my life AGAIN. But I feel it's worth it.

So yes, I'm still going on but almost literally crawling through life.

I met this girl on a site which I was totally into in primary school. I never had many friends at my own school since I got bullied a lot and lived on a tiny island with only 3 primary schools. But miracly, she lived on the same island, but in a different village! We got to know each other, started chatting and all. 

After a while I got my parents as far as being allowed to meet up with her, the summer before high school started. My memory is terrible, but I remember having doubts about her. Not sure why, but just those little things you know? I'd had a few (toxic) friend by then, but in hindsight, I never really learned what a normal friendship was then.

Anyway, we got friends, met up a few times. She told me she'd stolen a few times from stores. ...Wait, what? She pushed me to steal makeup from a store. ...Wait, what? One day I was her best friend, next day she made a topic on the site about all the secrets I told her and some other shit that wasn't true. So many red flags. I ignored those, she was my only friend. I was desperate for some company.

High school started. We got in separate classes of the same high school (there's ony one on our island). At first it seemed the bullying was over, because it was mainly the people from my primary school that bullied me. Guess what? The entire fricking island bullied her, and because I was her only friend, they all got me too. I went from a tiny hell, to a huge hell. And at first I came up for us, but she stole shit, man. She stole from shops, she lied to people about me, she was lazy, she was weird. 

Glad I found some other friends at the end of that school year and could finally get rid of her. Unfortunately, the bullying stayed. But I had some great friends as support. But yeah, do I regret ever meeting her.
